lines.zh: 我飘着走，身后拖着火星。
lines.en: I drift along, trailing sparks.

lines.zh: 我经过草地，草尖亮了一下。
lines.en: I pass the grass, and the tips gleam.

lines.zh: 我不踩地，只是低低地浮。
lines.en: I don't tread; I float low.

lines.zh: 我绕过一棵树，火星落在叶上。
lines.en: I skirt a tree, and sparks land on leaves.

lines.zh: 我朝更暗的地方飘过去。
lines.en: I drift toward the darker place.

lines.zh: 我的光一明一暗，像呼吸。
lines.en: My light rises and falls like breathing.
When I move, the air smells scorched.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地飘到你那一侧。
lines.en: I drift slowly to your side.

lines.zh: 我飘过水面，水上有一点亮。
lines.en: I drift over water, leaving a fleck of light.
My shape isn't quite fixed.

lines.zh: 我沿着石墙飘，影子跟着歪。
lines.en: I drift along the wall, my shadow leaning.
I turn, and sparks scatter.
I hang in the air, flame banked.
The fire on me doesn't burn.
I watch a flower open, slowly.
I dim, then brighten.
I'm about as light as ash.

lines.zh: 我的火星落在石上，灭了。
lines.en: A spark lands on stone and dies.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的钟声，没有回应。
lines.en: I hear a distant bell and don't answer.
I float here, settled.

lines.zh: 我的光把周围照得很小一圈。
lines.en: My light makes a small circle around me.

lines.zh: 我是灰烬里剩下的一点火。
lines.en: I'm the last bit of fire left in ash.

lines.zh: 我靠近一棵枯树，叶子跟着亮。
lines.en: I near a dead tree, and its leaves glow.

lines.zh: 我把火压小一点，别烧到什么。
lines.en: I bank my flame so nothing catches.
I wait for the night to deepen.
I turn once, slowly.

lines.zh: 我记得自己曾经有过手。
lines.en: I remember once having hands.
You came near, and I brightened.
My light is on your face.
There's no ash on your hands.
Like this, are you still afraid?
I've nothing to give you.
You carry a living warmth.
I come close, sparks circling you.
You look at me, and I brighten again.
I don't speak, yet you understand.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的火星就散了。
lines.en: You step back, and my sparks disperse.

lines.zh: 我记得有人这样看过我。
lines.en: I remember someone looked at me like that.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我光里变淡。
lines.en: Your shadow pales in my light.
I drift to your shoulder, light as air.
I dim, then brighten again.
Half my sparks scatter.
I retreat, drawing my light in.
I waver, my shape blurring.
I hear a small sound from myself.
I drop low to steady first.
It doesn't hurt; it's only wrong.
I'm still here; don't worry.

lines.zh: 你手里那点火，我想靠近。
lines.en: That little flame in your hand; I want near it.
Any wood? I'd like to burn brighter.
That glow puts me at ease.
I drift toward the fire.
You raise the flame, and I rise with it.
The embers in the ash still hold heat.
I won't swallow it; I only want to be near.
That burning thing; give it to me.
My sparks leap across.
Add a little more, and I'll be clearer.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，什么也没摸到。
lines.en: You touch me and feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，火星扑了一脸。
lines.en: We collide, and sparks splash over you.
I scatter a little and close again.
You pass through my light.
I press against you, warm.
I pull back, afraid of burning you.

lines.zh: 我的火苗歪了一下，就正了。
lines.en: My flame leans, then rights itself.
At our touch, the shadows join.
You knock a corner off me.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，往上升了一点。
lines.en: I skirt you and rise a little.
Another point of fire drifts far off.
We near, and our lights merge.
Her embers are whiter than mine.
We circle the same line.
She remembers more than I do.
We trade a little sparks.

lines.zh: 我们的光在墙上叠起来。
lines.en: Our lights overlap on the wall.
She drifts past me, slowly.
Two souls, one flame.

lines.zh: 天快亮时，我们靠在一起。
lines.en: Near dawn, we lean together.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块炭，含在光里。
lines.en: I pick up a coal and hold it in my glow.
I puff your fallen paper up.
I gather a flake of ash and carry it.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚羽毛，它没烧。
lines.en: I pick up a feather; it doesn't burn.

lines.zh: 我把一根枯枝点亮，递给你。
lines.en: I light a dry twig and offer it.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的火星，收回来。
lines.en: I pick up the sparks on the ground and call them back.

lines.zh: 我把你的手帕拾起来，还你。
lines.en: I pick up your handkerchief and return it.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片叶子，照了照。
lines.en: I pick up a leaf and shine on it.

lines.zh: 我把掉下去的光捞起来。
lines.en: I scoop up the fallen light.

lines.zh: 我捡起一小块石头，暖在光里。
lines.en: I pick up a pebble and warm it.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在烧，不是我。
lines.en: Something's burning over there, and it's not me.
I see it, that patch of black.
I drift that way.
It set the forest alight.
My sparks begin to gather.
That kind of fire shouldn't be here.
I brighten to light it up.
It fears light; I can tell.
I'll go first; don't follow too close.
It smells of ash.
I drop a spark on it.
I circle it without touching ground.

lines.zh: 我的光把它照得很清楚。
lines.en: My light shows it plainly.
It hides in the dark; I follow.
My sparks fly close to it.
Lighted, it retreats.
I stop above its head.
I gather my light into a point.
It raises a hand against the light; good.
I approach slowly, not to startle it.
I stay above it.

lines.zh: 它退到水边就不能再退。
lines.en: It backs to the water and can go no further.

lines.zh: 我的光和它的火碰上了。
lines.en: My light meets its fire.
I lunge, and sparks burst.
I press my light into it.
It's scorched once and retreats.
My fire won't burn people; it burns it.
I strike, light and bright.

lines.zh: 我的火星钻进它的缝里。
lines.en: My sparks work into its seams.
White smoke rises off it.
One more burn, and I'm brighter.
I withdraw and let the light burn.
In a heap of cold ash, a point lights up.
I rise from the embers.
The night wind blows me into shape.

lines.zh: 我记不清自己怎么来的。
lines.en: I can't recall how I came to be.
There was a fire here once.
My light comes first, my shape after.
I circle above the ash once.

lines.zh: 有人的脚步声，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear footsteps.
The fire died long ago; I remain.
I brighten slowly, as if waking.

lines.zh: 我的火星落回我的身体。
lines.en: My sparks fall back into me.
I almost remember who I was.

lines.zh: 灰堆上有一道浅痕，是我留的。
lines.en: A faint mark on the ash; I left it.

lines.zh: 火和我同源，却把我冲散了。
lines.en: Fire is my kin, yet it scatters me.
I fall, scattering sparks the way down.

lines.zh: 水把我压住，光只剩一点。
lines.en: Water presses me down; only a fleck of light stays.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹开，我慢慢聚回。
lines.en: The blast blows me apart; I slowly return.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，带走了一小团火。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and carries off a small flame.
A spell pins me where I am.
Without fuel, I thin away.

lines.zh: 雷光比我亮，我一瞬间不见了。
lines.en: The lightning outshines me, and I vanish for a moment.

lines.zh: 这里没有空气，我的火要灭了。
lines.en: There's no air here; my flame is dying.
